reason: An IM integration bridge that connects dsh agent sessions to WeChat, QQ, and Feishu, with proactive messaging, task callbacks, remote approvals, and status monitoring.

summaries.zh: 将 dsh 智能体会话接入微信、QQ 和飞书，并支持主动推送、任务回传、远程审批及状态通知。
summaries.en: Connects dsh agent sessions to WeChat, QQ, and Feishu with proactive messaging, task result callbacks, remote approvals, and status notifications.

capabilities: Connects to WeChat, QQ, and Feishu external messaging services
Stores and uses channel credentials and session tokens
Receives and sends text messages through configured channels
Proactively pushes messages and agent task results to external recipients
Forwards remote approval requests and task status updates through IM channels
